title: Stochastic models for the 3x+1 and 5x+1 problems
relevance: Foundational paper establishing the biased random walk heuristic for Collatz trajectories in log-space, deriving the drift constant and delay predictions that this concept module builds upon.

title: The Ultimate Challenge: The 3x+1 Problem
relevance: Comprehensive survey of the 3x+1 problem collecting probabilistic, dynamical, and computational perspectives; serves as the primary reference for the stochastic modeling approach and its limitations.

title: Almost all orbits of the Collatz map attain almost bounded values
relevance: Proves that almost all Collatz orbits reach values below f(n) for any f tending to infinity, rigorously validating the probabilistic intuition underlying the stochastic model.
